title: The singing monks
notes: Bible 7.1: Vesperine statues sing, mouths open; the choir plaque. The monks believed in the song; the Hornfolk covered their ears: two postures, same job.

pages.text:
(Along the choir, a row of carved monks with their mouths open. On the plinth of the first, a plaque:)

LET THE MOUTH BE OPEN THAT THE EAR BE SHUT. THE BROTHERS SING SO THE VALLEY MAY NOT HEAR.
